notes: Opt-in scoped request subscription with an Effect HTTP body decoder; owned Option result distinguishes absent from typed unavailable/incomplete errors. Plain snapshots and history retain no bodies. Use message.json or schemaBodyJson, or message.urlParamsBody for URL-encoded forms with repeated keys; select decoding explicitly rather than guessing from media type. Stock WebKit refuses empty or missing reports whose completeness is unknown.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
